check: what the mod does on startup when installed normally
authoritativeLine: The entrypoint logs it itself: [GreatWall:S0-01] Common entrypoint loaded; world generation disabled

calls.kind: registers lifecycle events that only maintain thread-local bookkeeping
registers the bundled biome datapack as NORMAL, so nothing activates without the operator enabling it
returns immediately unless a probe or fixture flag is set
guarded by isModLoaded, so the optional types are not even loaded unless those mods are present

conclusion: Installing the jar adds registrations and nothing else. No chunk is written, no biome is applied and no structure is placed, which is consistent with the S0-01 line the entrypoint prints.
